name: Ronin del Cielo
original_name: ローニン・デルシエロ
source:
An Agent belonging to the 5/13.

A man who rarely speaks, and never expresses emotion of any kind; many would even describe him as “mechanical.” 
As a result, those around him tend to doubt his faith.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
